Hi JB — quick update and fix steps.

What we found: the ingestion lambda was throwing an edge-case parse exception when file metadata contained a trailing dot in the filename (your W-9 filename was "w9_signed_jb.pdf."). That triggered the classification fallback which incorrectly set type=Contractor. The upload timeout you saw was a retry loop in our upload-service triggered by that parse exception in certain browser uploads.

What we did:
- Applied a hotfix to trim filename metadata and swallow the specific parse exception (no longer retries).
- Updated fallback classification from "Contractor" to "Pending Supplier Review" while the document is validated by our onboarding team.
- Re-ran the provisioning job for your token (onboarding-evg-20261021-xyz) — your account now shows Supplier:Active in Workday.

Next steps for you:
1) Please re-open your invite link and re-accept (https://app.workday.com/onboard/evergreen/accept?token=...). You should be routed to the supplier dashboard; you do not need to re-upload the W-9.
2) If you do re-upload, please remove any trailing punctuation from the filename — we also patched servers but this helps prevent client-side issues.

I've attached the repro provisioning log for transparency (repro-provisioning-log.txt) and linked the ticket SUP-4821 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SUP-4821). If you still see anything odd I'll escalate to Eng for a deeper trace.

Apologies for the trouble — we appreciate you flagging it and getting us the screenshot.
